prs.title: [rust-compiler] Fix Unicode diagnostic underline positions
prs.author: chengchuu
prs.body:
## Summary Fixes #37897 The experimental Rust Babel adapter misaligns diagnostic underlines after non-ASCII characters and can make underlines too long for multiline ranges. The formatter treats Babel’s UTF-16 source columns as UTF-8 byte offsets. To reproduce, compile this component with the adapter configured to use `panicThreshold: 'all_errors'`: ```jsx function App(props) { const text = "café"; props.value = text; return

{props.value}

; } ``` The props-mutation error is expected, but the Rust adapter places the underline on the space before `props`: ```text > 5 | const text = "café"; props.value = text; | ^^^^^ value cannot be modified ``` This change measures marker spacing and multiline lengths in UTF-16 code units to match Babel. Tab handling and ASCII behavior remain unchanged. ## How did you test this change? From the repository root on the PR branch, with Rust installed: ```bash cd compiler cargo test -p react_compiler_diagnostics code_frame::tests cargo test -p react_compiler_diagnostics ``` Both new regression tests failed with the original formatter and passed with the fix. All 9 diagnostics tests passed. Coverage includes ASCII, accented text, CJK characters, emoji, combining marks, tabs, and multiline ranges.
